subject: maths
question: 20 women can finish a piece of work in 16 days and 16 men can finish it in 15 days. What is the ratio of the working efficiency of a man and a woman?
solution:
**Given data:**

20 women can finish work in 16 days

16 men can finish the same work in 15 days

Formula Used:

Number of Men/women × number of days = total work

Calculation:

⇒ Total work of women = 20w × 16 = 320w

⇒ Total work of men = 16m × 15 = 240m

So, 320w = 240m 

⇒ m/w = 320/240 = 4/3

∴ Required ratio of the capacity of a man to a woman = 4 : 3
